page.layout: One page: the front board of a bound book, seen from the outside. No printed text. Blind-tooled ornamental frame on the board, two metal clasps with hinge plates at the right edge, raised bands on the spine at the left. A dark ink mark (a small coat of arms or stamp) sits near the centre of the board.
page.notes: Binding, not a printed page: a cover of pale limp vellum or parchment with blind-tooled ornamental borders and a central panel, with four raised spine bands at the left edge and two metal clasps at the right edge. A dark ink mark, possibly an armorial stamp or an ownership mark, lies in the centre of the panel. It is handwriting or a stamp, not printed text, and is left out. No text can be read on the board.
